notes: Answer list for the synthetic specification in spec/. A planted problem counts as found when a question cites at least one of its anchors (location.item_ids). It counts as found with the right kind when the question's kind is also in 'kinds' (the first one is the intended kind; the others are accepted readings). Non-issues are traps: a question that cites only non-issue anchors and matches no planted problem is a false positive.

problems.description: Session timeout is 30 minutes in the common rules but 60 minutes on the login screen.
The start date on SC-05 is entered as YYYY-MM-DD; CMN-R02 says YYYY/MM/DD everywhere.
SC-11 says the equipment manager also uses user management; the role matrix CMN-A06 allows only the system administrator. A wrong reading gives a non-admin the power to grant roles.
The account locks after 'a certain number' of failures; the number, the counting window and the unlock procedure (who, how, automatic or not) are not given.
The page size of the search result is 'as appropriate'.
SC-10 lists an equipment state 予約済 that is not one of the four states of OVR-T02, and no screen or rule sets or clears it.
The maximum loan period is 14 days on SC-05 but one month on SC-08, where the desk can also extend it without a new approval.
The length of the purpose field is not given.
The approver is the head of the applicant's department; who approves when the applicant is the department head, or when the head is absent, is not defined.
Nothing prevents two requests for the same item over overlapping periods: the item stays 貸出可 after approval, and no rule checks the schedule shown on SC-04.
Requests left untouched for 'a certain period' are 'processed automatically': the period, and whether they are approved or rejected, are not given.
SC-07 has a send-back (差戻し) button, but the request states of OVR-T03 have no such state, SC-06 offers no way to edit a request, and no mail is defined for it.
A damaged return is to be 'handled appropriately': the state to set, who is told and what the user must do are not given. SC-08-R03 meanwhile sets the item back to 貸出可.
Reminders go to the applicant 'and related persons'; who the related persons are is not defined.
The reminder batch runs 'at night' with no time, while OVR-N01 says the system is unavailable during the batch; the outage window cannot be known.
MAIL-02 (the reminder mail) is used on SC-09 but not defined in CMN-4.
The asset number has 10 characters on SC-08 and SC-10 but 8 in the CSV output of SC-12.
An item can be set to 廃棄 (or any state) by hand while it is on loan or has approved requests; what happens to those loans and requests is not defined.
A user who leaves while holding items, or with open requests or pending approvals, is simply disabled; what happens to the loans, the requests and the reminders is not defined.
The CSV character encoding, line ending and quoting are not given (Shift_JIS or UTF-8 matters for Excel).
'Responses must be fast' has no measurable target.
The system administrator manages announcements (OVR-R04) shown on SC-02, but no screen to register them exists and the role matrix has no row for it.
SC-11-R03 refers to a 登録 button that is not in the item list of SC-11, and the screen has no way to search users or open one for editing.

non_issues.description: The return date has no format note; CMN-R02 covers it (and the screen spec says the common spec applies when a screen is silent).
The category options are given by reference to SC-03-F02.
Whether weekends and holidays count as overdue days is stated explicitly.
The request number format and its example agree (R + 4-digit year + 5-digit sequence = 10 characters).
The comment field is marked not required, with a note that it is required for reject and send-back: a conditional rule, not a contradiction.

accepted_unplanned.description: Cancelling deletes the request, but no 取消 state exists; whether it is a physical or logical delete, and what happens to the request number and the history CSV, is not given. A real gap that was not planted on purpose.
Whether the desk may hand out an approved request before its start date or after its return date, and what happens to an approved request nobody collects.
The schedule on SC-04 shows only 承認済 requests, so the period of the current loan is not shown, and the request button is disabled while the item is on loan, so a future booking is impossible.
Initial password, password change and reset, and the complexity rule are not defined.
The department options, who maintains the department master, and how a department is tied to its approver are not defined.
